settings.heading: Return & Refund Policy
settings.content:
We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, you can contact us at info@ventayo.eu. Please note that returns will need to be sent to the following address that will be provided

If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

You can always contact us for any return question at info@ventayo.eu.


Damages and issues
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.


Exceptions / non-returnable items
Certain types of items cannot be returned, like perishable goods (such as food, flowers, or plants), custom products (such as special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (such as beauty products). We also do not accept returns for hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please get in touch if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.


Exchanges
The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.


European Union 14 day cooling off period
Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is being shipped into the European Union, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.


Refunds
We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved or not. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund too.
If more than 15 business days have passed since we’ve approved your return, please contact us at info@ventayo.eu.

Arctic Cooling AC Unit – Enjoy icy-cold air on the hottest summer days with your own personal portable air conditioner. Perfect for bedrooms, offices, dorms, or any indoor space.

Portable & Easy to Move – Equipped with four smooth-gliding caster wheels, this lightweight AC unit can be moved effortlessly from room to room and stored easily when not in use.


Energy Efficient – Uses less than 10W of electricity, making it a cost-effective cooling solution without the need for windows or permanent installation.


Swing Mode – The air swing function allows horizontal airflow automatically and manual vertical adjustment, ensuring even cooling throughout the room.


Timing Function – Set the 8-hour timer to automatically stop operation, allowing for comfortable sleep or energy savings.


Quiet Operation – Ultra-quiet design (<23dB) ensures a peaceful environment for sleep, work, or relaxation.


No Window Needed – Ductless design means no installation or venting through a window is required. Just add ice packs and water to enjoy cool, refreshing air.


Multipurpose Use – Functions as a fan or air cooler, ideal for small and large rooms alike.

This portable air conditioner isn’t just about lowering the temperature, it’s about creating a comfortable, refreshing environment wherever you are.

Simple Setup, Instant Comfort

Whether it’s your bedroom, office, dorm, or living space, this unit adapts to your lifestyle, giving you freedom, convenience, and relief from the heat whenever you need it.

settings.heading: Energy-Smart Cooling

Its energy-efficient system keeps your room comfortable all day long while helping you save on electricity costs. With adjustable airflow, timers, and easy-to-use controls, you can enjoy a perfectly cooled environment anytime without worrying about high energy bills.

The Portable Air Conditioner Indoor Room Cooler Stand Up AC Unit is now available. It provides refreshing and energizing air to homes and is perfect for when you are on the road. Our Portable Air Conditioner Cooling AC unit is undoubtedly the best option for your home.  

With this versatile air cooler, you can now have your own personal in-room air conditioner. It provides chilly air, keeps your skin moist, and provides fresh air all while saving you money.


Whether you need a windowless air conditioner or a portable air conditioner for when you travel, our indoor room air conditioner unit is excellent for large or small rooms and requires no windows at all.

You can control each aspect of the full-function Portable Air Conditioner Stand Up AC Unit from across the room. The portable air conditioner, unlike a fixed air conditioner unit, does not require permanent installation, and the smooth-gliding caster wheels allow for simple transportation from room to room.

This portable ac unit is simply the greatest multipurpose portable air conditioner with a cool air feeling for your hottest summer days. This portable air conditioner will help you get through the hottest, hottest days.

settings.heading: EFFECTIVE FILTRATION
settings.text: Breathe easier while you stay cool. The built-in filtration system captures dust, allergens, and other airborne particles while circulating refreshing air throughout your room. This means you can enjoy not only a cool environment but also cleaner, healthier air, making it perfect for bedrooms, offices, or dorm rooms. The filtration system works silently in the background, providing continuous protection without disrupting your daily routine, helping everyone in your home breathe better while staying comfortable during the hottest days of the year.

settings.heading: CUSTOMIZE YOUR AIRFLOW
settings.text: Take full control of your comfort with this portable AC unit. Featuring adjustable swing mode and directional airflow, you can easily direct the cool air exactly where you need it, whether it’s across a large living space or focused on a single area like your workspace or bed. The horizontal swing automatically circulates air throughout the room, while the vertical airflow can be manually adjusted for precise cooling. This level of customization ensures every corner of your room stays comfortable, allowing you to work, sleep, or relax in a perfectly cooled environment tailored to your preferences.

settings.heading: Does this portable air conditioner require a window for installation?
settings.row_content: No, this unit is completely windowless and does not require any permanent installation. You simply add water and ice packs, plug it in, and enjoy instant cool air. Its compact design and portability mean you can move it from room to room without any setup hassle.

settings.heading: How large of a room can this AC cool effectively?
settings.row_content: This stand-up portable air conditioner is designed to cool small to medium-sized rooms efficiently. While it provides a strong, refreshing airflow, the cooling effect is most effective in spaces like bedrooms, home offices, dormitories, or living rooms. It’s perfect for personal or shared spaces where immediate comfort is needed.

settings.heading: Is the unit noisy during operation?
settings.row_content: No, this AC operates at ultra-quiet levels (<23dB) even on higher settings. It’s suitable for sleeping, working, or studying without disturbing anyone in the room. The fan and cooling system are engineered to deliver maximum performance silently, providing comfort without distraction.

settings.heading: What makes this AC energy-efficient?
settings.row_content: Unlike traditional air conditioners, this portable unit uses minimal electricity while delivering powerful cooling. Its energy-efficient system helps you stay comfortable without worrying about high electricity bills. You can enjoy cool air all day long while keeping your energy costs low.

settings.heading: Can I adjust the airflow direction and settings?
settings.row_content: Yes! The AC features adjustable swing mode and directional airflow, allowing you to control horizontal and vertical air circulation. You can customize airflow to cool a specific area or circulate it evenly throughout the room, ensuring maximum comfort wherever you are.

settings.heading: Can I use this AC while traveling or in temporary locations?
settings.row_content: Yes! The portable design with caster wheels makes it perfect for travel, RVs, dorms, or temporary living spaces. No installation is required—simply plug it in, add ice packs, and enjoy cool air wherever you go.

settings.heading: How long does the cooling effect last when using ice packs?
settings.row_content: The cooling duration depends on the room size and the amount of ice added. Generally, adding all included ice packs provides several hours of continuous cool airflow. You can refresh the ice packs as needed for extended cooling throughout the day.
